# I_DistortChroma (algorithm reference)

No upstream source is vendored here. This directory only keeps the upstream MIT license text
for the Distort Chroma effect (`src/shaders/distortChroma.frag.glsl`), which is a GLSL
re-implementation of the algorithm in `I_DistortChroma/Shaders/DistortChromaShader.hlsl`.

- Upstream: https://github.com/panko200/I_DistortChroma
- Referenced commit: 3e34c6839fd3f017d8fbd21f4538eafbbafc31a4
- License: MIT, Copyright (c) 2026 panko200
